title: The whole High School Top 10, and the three theories it destroys
title_zh: 整個高中組 Top 10，以及它推翻的三個理論
lede: Reading all ten rather than three kills three tempting explanations, including one argued on this very page. Statistical reporting does not track placing — the team with the most of it won nothing. Registry documentation runs the other way: **the Grand Prize winner has the shortest of all ten.** And "nominate one clear claim" is not sufficient either, because the clearest headline among the non-finalists placed nowhere. What does hold is bleaker and more useful: **seven of seven non-podium teams stop at a surrogate for their own stated target, and exactly one team in the ten ever tested a real sample.**
lede_zh: 把十支隊伍一起讀，而不是只讀三支，會殺掉三個誘人的解釋，其中一個還是本頁自己主張過的。統計報告方式與名次無關——報告得最齊全的那支什麼都沒拿。Registry 文件的方向則是反的：**總冠軍的文件是十支裡最短的。** 而「指定一個清楚的主張」也不夠，因為非決賽隊伍中標題最清楚的那一支，什麼名次都沒有。真正撐得住的結論更冷峻，也更有用：**七支非頒獎台隊伍全部停在自己所宣稱目標的替代物上，而這十支之中，只有一支真正測過真實樣本。**
body:
The three-team comparison above could be accused of fitting a story to one outcome, so the same questions were put to the whole cohort. Six of the ten results pages are server-rendered and were fetched directly; two are client-rendered and were read in a browser; one team has no results page at all. The table below is what a reader can actually check on each.

Three explanations die here. **Statistical reporting**: HongKong-HS carries ANOVA, Dunnett's post-hoc, a t-test, n=3 and standard deviations, and won nothing; the Grand Prize winner names no test and reports no p-value. **Registry documentation**: measured consistently across all ten, the medians run from HKSSC's 23,116 characters per headline part down to Lambert-GA's 670 — the Grand Prize winner last, the runner-up eighth, and the three longest all belonging to parts-prize winners who reached no podium. **And the one-claim theory from the section above**: HangzhouFourteenAP states that a four-enzyme cocktail cut biofilm biomass 57.1% against control with ANOVA F(5,12) = 29.8, p < 0.001 — one sentence, quantified, test named — and took a village award and nothing more.

Two further sorting theories fail on structure alone. Eton-College-UK reached the Top 10 **with no results page and no parts page**, 24 of its 29 Registry entries being PCR primers. HKSSC placed **on a Silver medal** while the other nine hold Gold. And parts awards do not lead anywhere: GCGS, GHCIS and HKSSC each won one, all three finished outside the podium, and the two finalists won none between them.

What survives is a wall rather than a formula. Every one of the seven non-podium teams examined in depth substitutes something convenient for the thing its project is actually about — synthetic trigger RNA for river water, a synthetic oligonucleotide for urine, a tolerance shift for paraben removal, *B. subtilis* for *S. mutans*, a reporter for a therapy — and stops there. **One team in the ten ran its sensor on a real sample, a soil extract, and that team is the 1st Runner-up.** With ten teams and two podium places this cannot carry a causal claim, and it is reported as the one line the podium sits on the right side of.

The two finalists then reached the slate by routes that do not resemble each other: Lambert-GA on **novelty** — a de novo binder reported as a first, measured by a commercial service, on a project whose other arm has no data — and HongKong-JSS on **depth**, five independent matched runs across 51 treatments with leave-one-run-out re-analyses and a selectivity panel. **GEMS took neither route.** Its novel element showed no light dependence in its own ELISA, with every biological result coming from the constitutive bypass; and its genuine depth, the plant work at p < 0.0001 with 40 seedlings per condition, sits on a protectant the reactor did not make, since the preparation sprayed on the plants was never assayed. That is a more precise and less comfortable answer than the one the section above reaches alone, and it is the one the full cohort supports.
body_zh:
上面那份三隊比較，可能會被質疑是「為一個結果編一個故事」，所以同樣的問題被拿去問整個群體。十份結果頁中有六份是伺服器端渲染、直接抓取；兩份是用戶端渲染，以瀏覽器讀取；還有一支隊伍完全沒有結果頁。下面的表格就是「讀者在每一支身上實際能核對什麼」。

三個解釋在這裡死掉。**統計報告方式**：HongKong-HS 有 ANOVA、Dunnett 事後檢定、t-test、n=3 與標準差，什麼都沒拿；而總冠軍沒有寫出檢定名稱，也沒有 p 值。**Registry 文件**：用一致方式量過全部十支，每個招牌元件的中位數從 HKSSC 的 23,116 字元一路降到 Lambert-GA 的 670——總冠軍最後一名、亞軍第八名，而最長的三支全都是拿了元件獎卻沒上頒獎台的隊伍。**還有上一節那個「一個主張」的理論**：HangzhouFourteenAP 寫出四酵素複方把生物膜量相對對照降低 57.1%，ANOVA F(5,12) = 29.8、p < 0.001——一句話、有量化、寫出檢定名稱——結果只拿到一個 village 獎，別無其他。

另外兩個排序理論光從結構上就不成立。Eton-College-UK 在**沒有結果頁、也沒有元件頁**的情況下進了 Top 10，而它 29 個 Registry 條目中有 24 個是 PCR 引子。HKSSC 是**以銀牌**進榜，而其他九支都是金牌。元件獎也通不到任何地方：GCGS、GHCIS 與 HKSSC 各拿一個，三支全在頒獎台之外，而兩支決賽隊伍加起來一個也沒有。

撐下來的不是一個公式，而是一道牆。被深入檢視的七支非頒獎台隊伍，每一支都用某個方便的東西替代了自己專案真正要處理的東西——用合成觸發 RNA 替代河水、用合成寡核苷酸替代尿液、用耐受度位移替代對羥基苯甲酸酯的移除、用 *B. subtilis* 替代 *S. mutans*、用報告子替代療法——然後就停在那裡。**十支隊伍中只有一支把自己的感測器用在真實樣本上，一份土壤萃取液，而那支隊伍是亞軍。** 十支隊伍、兩個席次，這無法承載因果論述，因此它只被當成「頒獎台站在正確一側」的那一條線來報告。

而兩支決賽隊伍進入名單的路徑，彼此並不相像：Lambert-GA 靠的是**新穎性**——一個從頭設計的結合分子，被報告為首例，量測由商業服務完成，而這個專案的另一支沒有任何資料；HongKong-JSS 靠的是**深度**——五組獨立配對試驗、涵蓋 51 個處理，附逐一剔除整組的重分析與選擇性測試。**GEMS 兩條路都沒走。** 它新穎的那個元素，在它自己的 ELISA 裡沒有顯示光依賴性，所有生物學成果都來自組成型旁路；而它真正的深度——每組 40 棵幼苗、p < 0.0001 的植物工作——建立在一份並非反應器做出來的保護蛋白上，因為噴到植物上的那份製備從未被檢測活性。這個答案比上一節單獨得到的更精確、也更不舒服，而它是整個群體的證據所支持的那一個。

cards.title: Seven of seven non-podium teams stop at a surrogate, and not one tested a real sample
cards.title_zh: 七支非頒獎台隊伍全部停在替代物上，沒有一支測過真實樣本
cards.body:
This is the strongest pattern in the cohort, and it is not about the podium — it is about everyone else. GHCIS built a field water-monitoring tool whose only analyte has ever been its own synthetic trigger RNA at micromolar concentrations, three to six orders of magnitude from use. HongKong-HS built a home urine test that has never touched urine, demonstrating a floor of 100 nM synthetic oligonucleotide — roughly a million-fold above urinary miRNA. HKSSC claims paraben removal and measures a tolerance shift instead; its HPLC produced chromatograms and no quantification. GCGS built a sensor and an effector that both work and never joined them. HFI's premise experiment is labelled "ns, not significant" in its own figure legend. HangzhouFourteenAP used *B. subtilis* as a stand-in for *S. mutans*, one dose, once. Eton tested one protease at two concentrations, with no results page to gather it.

**HongKong-JSS is the only team in the ten that ran its sensor on a real sample** — a soil extract — and it is on the podium. That is not proof of a mechanism, with ten teams and two podium places. But it is the one line on the table that the podium sits on the right side of.
cards.body_zh:
這是整個群體裡最強的模式，而它談的不是頒獎台，而是其他所有人。GHCIS 做了一個現地水質監測工具，而它的分析對象至今只有自己合成的觸發 RNA，濃度在微莫耳等級，距離實際使用相差三到六個數量級。HongKong-HS 做了一個居家尿液檢測，卻從未碰過尿液，所展示的下限是 100 nM 的合成寡核苷酸——大約比尿中 miRNA 高出一百萬倍。HKSSC 聲稱要移除對羥基苯甲酸酯，實際量到的卻是耐受度的位移；它的 HPLC 只產出層析圖，沒有定量。GCGS 做出了一個感測器和一個效應器，兩個都能動，卻從未接起來。HFI 檢驗自身前提的那個實驗，在它自己的圖說上被標成「ns，不顯著」。HangzhouFourteenAP 用 *B. subtilis* 代替 *S. mutans*，單一劑量、施用一次。Eton 測了一種蛋白酶的兩個濃度，而且沒有結果頁可以把它收攏起來。

**HongKong-JSS 是這十支裡唯一把自己的感測器用在真實樣本上的隊伍**——一份土壤萃取液——而它在頒獎台上。十支隊伍、兩個頒獎台席次，這不足以證明因果。但它是這張表上唯一一條「頒獎台站在正確一側」的線。
chips_zh: 10 支中 1 支測過真實樣本

cards.title: The two finalists got there by different routes, and GEMS took neither
cards.title_zh: 兩支決賽隊伍走的是不同的路，而 GEMS 兩條都沒走
cards.body:
There is no single podium formula in this cohort, because the two finalists do not resemble each other. **Lambert-GA's route is novelty**: a de novo designed minibinder reported as the first confirmed to bind its viral target, measured by a commercial service, on a project whose other arm has no data at all and whose results page carries no statistics. **HongKong-JSS's route is depth**: five independent matched runs across 51 treatments, paired statistics, two leave-one-run-out re-analyses, a selectivity panel against three competing metals, and the only real-sample trial in the ten — on a project that openly refuses to call its headline number a limit of detection.

One team was rewarded for doing something nobody had done; the other for proving a modest thing to a standard nobody else reached. **GEMS has neither.** Its novel element, green-light control of *B. subtilis*, showed no light dependence in its own ELISA, and every biological result came from the constitutive bypass. Its depth is real in the plant work but sits on an input the reactor did not make — the preparation sprayed on the plants was never assayed, and the chain was never run end to end. The two available routes to a finalist slate were novelty and depth, and ReLEAF's novelty is unevidenced while its depth is on the wrong link.
cards.body_zh:
這個群體裡沒有單一的頒獎台公式，因為兩支決賽隊伍彼此並不相像。**Lambert-GA 走的是新穎性**：一個從頭設計的 minibinder，被報告為首次確認能結合其病毒標的，量測由商業服務完成；而這個專案的另一支完全沒有資料，結果頁上也沒有任何統計。**HongKong-JSS 走的是深度**：五組獨立配對試驗、涵蓋 51 個處理、配對統計、兩次逐一剔除整組的重分析、對三種競爭金屬的選擇性測試，以及十支隊伍中唯一的真實樣本試驗——而這個專案公開拒絕把自己的招牌數字稱為偵測極限。

一支隊伍因為做了沒人做過的事而被獎勵；另一支因為把一件樸素的事證明到沒人達到的標準而被獎勵。**GEMS 兩者都沒有。** 它新穎的那個元素，*B. subtilis* 的綠光控制，在它自己的 ELISA 裡沒有顯示光依賴性，而所有生物學成果都來自組成型旁路。它的深度在植物工作上是真的，但那建立在一個不是反應器做出來的投入上——噴到植物上的那份製備從未被檢測活性，鏈條也從未端到端跑過。通往決賽席位的兩條路是新穎性與深度，而 ReLEAF 的新穎性沒有證據，它的深度長在錯的那一環上。

cards.title: "Nominate one claim" is not sufficient either — the clearest headline of the seven placed nowhere
cards.title_zh: 「指定一個主張」也不夠——七支裡標題最清楚的那一支什麼名次都沒有
cards.body:
The three-team comparison on this page argues that the finalists each resolve into one repeatable sentence while GEMS publishes five key results. That holds for those three. **It does not survive the other seven.** HangzhouFourteenAP has the single clearest headline in the non-podium group: a four-enzyme cocktail cut residual biofilm biomass by **57.1%** against a PBS control, with ANOVA F(5,12) = 29.8, p < 0.001, n = 3, and each single-enzyme omission significantly worse. That is one sentence, quantified, with a statistical test named. It won a village award and nothing else. GCGS states a limit of detection of **53.1 nM** C4-HSL with a fitted line and R² = 0.894. HKSSC reports its enzyme beating a commercial esterase by **2.09×** at equal mass, defended through a cascade from two-way ANOVA to Brown-Forsythe to Welch with Holm correction.

So having one legible claim is not what buys a placing. **What those three claims have in common is that each is a claim about a surrogate** — an artificial calculus model, a synthetic signalling molecule, a model ester. The sentence was clear; the thing it was about was not the thing the project was for.
cards.body_zh:
本頁的三隊比較主張：兩支決賽隊伍各自收斂成一句可複述的話，而 GEMS 發表了五個重點成果。對那三支來說成立。**但它撐不過其他七支的檢驗。** HangzhouFourteenAP 在非頒獎台群體裡擁有最清楚的單一標題：四酵素複方把殘餘生物膜量相對 PBS 對照降低了 **57.1%**，ANOVA F(5,12) = 29.8、p < 0.001、n = 3，而且每一個單酵素缺項的表現都顯著更差。那就是一句話、有量化、還寫出了檢定名稱。它拿到一個 village 獎，其他什麼都沒有。GCGS 寫出 C4-HSL 的偵測極限 **53.1 nM**，附擬合直線與 R² = 0.894。HKSSC 報告它的酵素在等質量下比商用酯酶高 **2.09 倍**，並以 two-way ANOVA 到 Brown-Forsythe 再到 Welch 加 Holm 校正的一整串檢定來防守。

所以「有一個清楚可讀的主張」並不是換到名次的東西。**那三個主張的共同點是：每一個都是關於替代物的主張**——一個人工牙垢模型、一個合成訊號分子、一個模型酯類。句子是清楚的；但句子講的那個東西，不是這個專案存在的理由。
chips_zh: 句子清楚，主詞是替代物

cards.title: The Grand Prize winner has the shortest Registry documentation of all ten
cards.title_zh: 總冠軍的 Registry 文件是十支裡最短的
cards.body:
Measured consistently — total documentation payload across design, experiment, characterisation and discussion sections, six headline parts per team — the medians run: **HKSSC 23,116 · HFI 17,493 · GCGS 14,763 · GEMS-Taiwan 8,644 · HangzhouFourteenAP 7,786 · HongKong-HS 4,944 · HongKong-JSS 2,606 · GHCIS 1,969 · Eton 1,903 · Lambert-GA 670.** The Grand Prize winner is last; the 1st Runner-up is eighth. The longest belong to the three teams that won parts prizes and reached no podium — HKSSC's Best New Basic Part alone carries 50,189 characters.

**Long Registry documentation buys a parts prize, not a placing.** It is still the right thing to write, because it is the one artefact that outlives the season and the only way a stranger can reuse the work. But it should be budgeted as a contribution rather than as a bid for the podium. One warning for anyone repeating this measurement: the short `description` field is a different quantity from the documentation payload and is not a proxy for it — HKSSC's best part has a 265-character description and 50,189 characters of documentation.
cards.body_zh:
用一致的方式量測——每隊取六個招牌元件，把 design、experiment、characterisation、discussion 各段落的文件內容加總——中位數依序是：**HKSSC 23,116 · HFI 17,493 · GCGS 14,763 · GEMS-Taiwan 8,644 · HangzhouFourteenAP 7,786 · HongKong-HS 4,944 · HongKong-JSS 2,606 · GHCIS 1,969 · Eton 1,903 · Lambert-GA 670。** 總冠軍是最後一名；亞軍第八。最長的屬於那三支拿了元件獎、卻沒上頒獎台的隊伍——HKSSC 的 Best New Basic Part 單一元件就有 50,189 字元。

**長篇的 Registry 文件換得的是元件獎，不是名次。** 它仍然該寫，因為那是唯一比賽季活得更久的產物，也是陌生人能重複利用這份工作的唯一途徑。但它應該被當成一項貢獻來編列預算，不是當成爭取頒獎台的投注。給任何想重複這個量測的人一個警告：簡短的 `description` 欄位與文件內容總長是兩個不同的量，不能互相代用——HKSSC 最好的那個元件，description 只有 265 字元，文件內容卻有 50,189 字元。

cards.title: Statistical reporting does not track placing either
cards.title_zh: 統計報告方式同樣與名次無關
cards.body:
**HongKong-HS reports ANOVA, Dunnett's post-hoc, a t-test, n=3 and standard deviations — and won nothing at all.** HKSSC defends its headline through two-way ANOVA, a Brown-Forsythe test and Welch with Holm correction, and won one parts award on a Silver medal. The **Grand Prize winner names no statistical test, reports no p-value and gives no replicate count**; its single quantitative claim is a confidence interval produced by a commercial service. Five of the ten publish no p-value anywhere, and only four name any test.

This reproduces the measurement-discipline null from elsewhere in this report (27% against 29% across all 106 decorated teams) inside a cohort of ten. The distinction worth keeping is between **reporting machinery and replication depth**: HongKong-HS has the machinery on n=3 in buffer, while HongKong-JSS has five independent matched runs on a real extract. **Only the second kind appears to travel.**
cards.body_zh:
**HongKong-HS 報告了 ANOVA、Dunnett 事後檢定、t-test、n=3 與標準差——結果什麼都沒拿。** HKSSC 用 two-way ANOVA、Brown-Forsythe 檢定，以及加上 Holm 校正的 Welch 來防守它的招牌結果，以銀牌拿下一個元件獎。而**總冠軍沒有寫出任何統計檢定名稱、沒有任何 p 值、也沒有任何重複數**；它唯一的量化主張是一個由商業服務做出來的信賴區間。十支隊伍中有五支完全沒有 p 值，只有四支寫出任何檢定名稱。

這把本報告別處那個「量測嚴謹度」的虛無結果（全部 106 支得獎隊伍中 27% 對 29%）在十支隊伍的群體裡再現了一次。值得保留的區分是**報告的機械裝置**與**重複的深度**之間的差別：HongKong-HS 在緩衝液裡用 n=3 配上整套裝置，而 HongKong-JSS 是在真實萃取液上做了五組獨立配對試驗。**看起來只有後面那一種會傳遞出去。**

cards.title: One award maps onto the finalist slate exactly, and it is Best Model
cards.title_zh: 有一個獎項與決賽名單完全對應，而那是最佳模型
cards.body:
Across the ten, Best Model recognition lands on exactly the two finalists and nobody else: Lambert-GA won Best Model (High School), HongKong-JSS was nominated, and no other team in the Top 10 appears in that category. By contrast Best Hardware and Best Measurement both went to a team that did not reach the podium.

The caveat is real and should be read before the finding: **this is an award predicting an award**, judged partly by the same kind of panel, so it is close to circular, and with ten teams and two slots a clean binary split can arise by luck. Still, it is the only award-level signal in the cohort that lines up 2 for 2, and it points somewhere plausible — a model is where a team has to state what it predicts and then be held to it. Two of the seven non-podium teams examined have **no modelling page at all**; both `/gcgs/model` and `/hongkong-hs/model` return 404. GEMS has a substantial model page, and it is the page that publishes the 68-year payback beside its own 4.9-year figure.
cards.body_zh:
在這十支隊伍中，最佳模型的肯定恰好落在兩支決賽隊伍身上，其他人都沒有：Lambert-GA 拿下最佳模型（高中組），HongKong-JSS 入圍，而 Top 10 裡沒有其他隊伍出現在這個類別。相對地，最佳硬體與最佳量測都頒給了一支沒有進頒獎台的隊伍。

這裡有一個真實的保留，而且應該先讀它再讀結論：**這是「用一個獎預測另一個獎」**，評審組成部分相近，所以接近循環論證；而十支隊伍、兩個席次，一個乾淨的二分完全可能是運氣。但它仍是這個群體裡唯一 2 比 2 完全對上的獎項層級訊號，而它指向的地方是說得通的——模型正是一支隊伍必須寫下「我預測什麼」並為此負責的地方。被檢視的七支非頒獎台隊伍中，有兩支**完全沒有模型頁**；`/gcgs/model` 與 `/hongkong-hs/model` 都回傳 404。GEMS 有一個紮實的模型頁，而那正是公開「68 年回本期」與自家「4.9 年」並列的那一頁。

cards.title: Eton-College-UK reached the Top 10 without a results page
cards.title_zh: Eton-College-UK 在沒有結果頁的情況下進了 Top 10
cards.body:
Eton's wiki has description, contribution, implementation, engineering, protocols, notebook, model, three modelling sub-pages, hardware, human practices, education, a game, team and attributions. **It has no results page**, and no parts page either, while 24 of its 29 Registry submissions are PCR primers. Its device claim rests on one protease at two concentrations, and its own text reports failed self-assembled-monolayer formation on some runs and large sensor-to-sensor variation.

It is also **the most transparent team of the ten** on criterion 6, stating plainly that it had no access to suitable labs and secured two weeks of bought time at the University of Greenwich and King's College London, and publishing a named adult's follow-up gel as a figure. Neither the missing pages nor the candour moved it. Alongside GCGS reaching the Top 10 with no model page, the lesson is that **the Top 10 is not a documentation score** — but a missing claim is not survivable in the way a missing page is.
cards.body_zh:
Eton 的 wiki 有 description、contribution、implementation、engineering、protocols、notebook、model、三個模型子頁、hardware、human practices、education、一個遊戲、team 與 attributions。**它沒有結果頁**，也沒有元件頁，而它 29 個 Registry 送交項目中有 24 個是 PCR 引子。它的裝置主張建立在一種蛋白酶的兩個濃度上，而它自己的文字也記載了某些批次自組裝單層形成失敗，以及感測器之間差異很大。

它同時是這十支隊伍中**在第 6 題上最透明的一支**，明白寫出自己沒有合適的實驗室可用，因而在 University of Greenwich 與 King's College London 買了兩週的實驗室時間，並把一位具名成年人後續補做的膠體圖當成一張圖發表。缺少的頁面沒有拖累它，坦白也沒有幫到它。再加上 GCGS 在沒有模型頁的情況下進了 Top 10，這裡的教訓是：**Top 10 不是一個文件評分**——但「缺少一個主張」不像「缺少一個頁面」那樣活得下去。
chips_zh: 29 個元件中 24 個是引子

cards.title: Six of seven non-podium teams disclose nothing usable about who did the work
cards.title_zh: 七支非頒獎台隊伍中有六支，對「誰做了這些工作」沒有提供任何可用的揭露
cards.body:
HangzhouFourteenAP's attributions page is the **unedited iGEM template**. GCGS, GHCIS and HongKong-HS have no attributions page at all. HKSSC's points off-wiki. HFI's is an empty iframe. Only Eton gives a reader anything to work with, and Eton is the most forthcoming team in the cohort.

This matters because question 6 asks how much of the work the team did itself, and a judge can only answer from what is published. **Both finalists published detailed, in some places unflattering, attributions** — HongKong-JSS disclosing that it did no cloning at all and that its supervisor prepared every mercury solution, Lambert disclosing that a commercial service produced, ran and interpreted the measurement its Grand Prize rests on. Neither was punished. **The pattern across the ten is that disclosure is free and silence is not obviously rewarded** — and for GEMS, whose own attributions page credits an advisor with designing the bioreactor and photometer from idea generation through CAD modelling, the lesson is that the exposure comes from what there is to disclose, not from disclosing it.
cards.body_zh:
HangzhouFourteenAP 的 attributions 頁是**未經編輯的 iGEM 範本**。GCGS、GHCIS 與 HongKong-HS 完全沒有 attributions 頁。HKSSC 的連到站外。HFI 的是一個空的 iframe。只有 Eton 給了讀者一些可用的東西，而 Eton 是這個群體裡最坦白的隊伍。

這件事重要，因為第 6 題問的是「多少工作是團隊自己做的」，而評審只能依據已公開的內容回答。**兩支決賽隊伍都發表了詳細、在某些地方並不好看的 attributions**——HongKong-JSS 揭露它完全沒有做選殖、所有汞溶液都由指導老師配製；Lambert 揭露那個支撐其總冠軍的量測，是由一家商業服務製備、執行並解讀的。兩者都沒有因此被懲罰。**十支隊伍的模式是：揭露是免費的，而沉默也沒有明顯被獎勵**——而對 GEMS 來說，它自己的 attributions 頁把生物反應器與光度計「從構想到 CAD 建模」的設計記在一位顧問名下；這裡的教訓是，暴露來自「有什麼要揭露」，不是來自「去揭露它」。

checklist: Before anything else in 2027, decide what the real sample is and get hold of it early. One team in ten tested one, and it is the only team on the right side of that line.
Pick a route deliberately: novelty, or depth on something modest. Lambert took the first, HongKong-JSS the second, and trying for both without finishing either is how GEMS spent 2026.

Make the novel element the one you validate hardest. If the light-gated device cannot beat the constitutive control, the project is not an optogenetics project, and that should be settled in week six.

Do not build the plan around out-rigouring the field. The team with the most statistical machinery in this section won nothing; depth of replication on a real matrix is the kind that appears to travel.
Budget Registry documentation as a contribution that outlives the season, not as a bid for a placing. The Grand Prize winner has the shortest in the cohort.
Write a real attributions page. Six of seven non-podium teams publish nothing usable, both finalists disclosed heavily and neither was punished for it.
Then ask one stranger the only question that matters: after two minutes on this wiki, what did this project achieve, and on what?
checklist_zh: 2027 年在做任何其他事之前，先決定「真實樣本」是什麼，並且及早把它弄到手。十支隊伍裡只有一支測過真實樣本，而那是唯一站在這條線正確一側的隊伍。
刻意選一條路：新穎性，或是在一件樸素的事上做到深度。Lambert 選了前者，HongKong-JSS 選了後者；兩邊都想要、兩邊都沒做完，正是 GEMS 2026 年的過法。
讓新穎的那個元素成為你驗證得最用力的一個。如果光控裝置贏不過組成型對照組，這個專案就不是光遺傳學專案，而這件事應該在第六週就定案。
不要把計畫建立在「比全場更嚴謹」上。這一組統計裝置最齊全的隊伍什麼都沒拿；真正會傳遞出去的，是在真實基質上的重複深度。
把 Registry 文件當成一項比賽季活得更久的貢獻來編預算，不是當成爭取名次的投注。總冠軍的文件是整組最短的。
寫一份真正的 attributions 頁。七支非頒獎台隊伍中有六支沒有提供任何可用的內容，而兩支決賽隊伍都大量揭露，也都沒有因此被懲罰。
然後去問一個陌生人唯一重要的那個問題：在這個 wiki 上待兩分鐘之後，這個專案達成了什麼，又是在什麼東西上達成的？
method: Results pages for GCGS, GHCIS, HFI, HKSSC, HongKong-HS and Lambert-GA are server-rendered and were fetched directly with curl and a browser User-Agent; Eton-College-UK's and HangzhouFourteenAP's wikis are client-rendered and were read in a browser; Eton has no results page, so its row describes an absence. Counts of named tests, p-values, replicate counts and dispersion measures come from stripping tags from each page and matching whole words, so a test named only inside a figure image, a PDF or a collapsed panel is invisible to this method, and roughly a third of 2026 wikis do hide content in click-to-open panels — these are floors, not totals. Registry figures are total documentation payload from /v1/parts/{uuid}/documentation, summed across design, experiment, characterisation and discussion sections, for six headline parts per team, 58 parts in all; the short description field is a separate quantity and is not a proxy for it, so the two are never compared here. The API throttles to HTTP 429 with retry-after values up to about 500 seconds, so the remaining accessions are recorded as unresolved rather than estimated. "Stops at" is each team's own account of its limit wherever one is published, and otherwise the furthest point its results actually reach; it is a reading of the published record, not a judgement of the science. The Best Model observation is an award predicting an award and is close to circular; with ten teams and two podium places, any binary split has a fair chance of lining up by luck, and no causal claim is made from it. Question 9, on the live judging session, is excluded throughout this tab because it leaves no public record, and part of what separated these teams may well have happened there. GEMS-Taiwan is the report author's own team and is scored on the same lines as the other nine.
method_zh: GCGS、GHCIS、HFI、HKSSC、HongKong-HS 與 Lambert-GA 的結果頁是伺服器端渲染，以 curl 搭配瀏覽器 User-Agent 直接取得；Eton-College-UK 與 HangzhouFourteenAP 的 wiki 是用戶端渲染，以瀏覽器讀取；Eton 沒有結果頁，因此它那一列描述的是「缺少」。檢定名稱、p 值、重複數與離散度的計數，是把每一頁去除標籤後以完整字詞比對而得，因此若某個檢定名稱只出現在圖片、PDF 或折疊面板裡，這個方法就看不到它；而 2026 年大約三分之一的 wiki 確實把內容藏在點擊展開的面板中——這些是下界，不是總數。Registry 的數字是 /v1/parts/{uuid}/documentation 的文件內容總長，涵蓋 design、experiment、characterisation、discussion 各段落，每隊取六個招牌元件，共 58 個元件；簡短的 description 欄位是另一個量，不能代用，因此本頁從不把兩者相比。該 API 會節流到 HTTP 429，retry-after 可達約 500 秒，因此其餘編號記為未取得，而非推估。「停在哪裡」一欄，凡團隊自己公開寫明其限制者即採用其說法，否則採用其結果實際達到的最遠點；這是對公開紀錄的閱讀，不是對科學本身的評判。最佳模型那項觀察是「用一個獎預測另一個獎」，接近循環論證；十支隊伍、兩個頒獎台席次，任何二分都有相當機率是運氣對上的，因此不由它導出任何因果主張。第 9 題關於現場問答，在本頁全程排除，因為它沒有留下公開紀錄，而把這些隊伍分開的因素，很可能有一部分正發生在那裡。GEMS-Taiwan 是本報告作者自己的團隊，與其他九支以相同標準評分。
